<p class="hero-subtitle">PhD in Mathematics · Sorbonne Université</p>

<p class="hero-intro" style="font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.7; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; max-width: 690px;">I am a mathematician working in probability, random graphs, and statistical inference. ## Research interests

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Random graphs

Random recursive structures, network archaeology, root finding, and evolving networks.
:::
::: {.feature-card}
### Statistical inference

Graphical models, property testing, and efficient use of covariance queries.
:::
::: {.feature-card}
### Quantum error correction

Developing research interests in quantum codes and probabilistic decoding methods.
:::
:::
